response.text: Invoice 802 (credit memo) debits AP 2000 and credits 5100, so it is in fact consistent as a credit memo. Next I'll check the payment journals against payments, the reversal, and posting-date checks.

arguments.sql: with pj as (select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", sum(l."DR_AMT") filter (where trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') dr2000, sum(l."CR_AMT") filter (where trim(l."ACCT_CD")='1000') cr1000 from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l using("JRNL_NO") where h."SRC_CD"='AP' and h."SRC_REF" like 'PAY-%' group by 1,2,3,4,5) select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT", pj.* from "APPAYM" p full join pj on pj."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" where pj."JRNL_NO" is null or p."PAY_ID" is null or pj.dr2000<>p."PAY_AMT" or pj.cr1000<>p."PAY_AMT" order by 1 limit 50

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."REF_JRNL_NO", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l using("JRNL_NO") where h."JRNL_NO" in (2320,2446) or h."REF_JRNL_NO" is not null order by 1,l."LN_SEQ"

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", i."INV_ID", i."INV_DT" from "GLJRNH" h left join "APINVH" i on i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where h."SRC_CD"='AP' and h."SRC_REF" not like 'PAY-%' and (h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT" or i."INV_ID" is null or h."MEMO"<>'Invoice '||i."INV_NO") order by 1 limit 30
select "SRC_CD", "POST_FLG", count(*), count(distinct "SRC_REF"), min("JRNL_NO"), max("JRNL_NO") from "GLJRNH" group by 1,2
